During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fielded this heavy class of '''[[Battleship/Legends|battleship]]'''<ref name="POTJSB" /> and divided command of the ships between the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:JfleetDeneba.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A battleship heads for [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]] along with a fleet of smaller vessels.]]
These heavy vessels in the Republic's fleet were long blocks of superstructure, often capped in the center with one or more command towers, and reinforced in some areas with thick, uniform armor.
Along their sides were engine-banks clustered in "islands", connected to the main hull.<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" />

Apart from these attributes, the battleships had a certain degrees of individual design,<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" /> much like the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]] of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
Similar in design to the larger [[Republic command ship]] ''[[Reliance I]]'', these battleships formed the main assault fleet at the [[Battle of Koros Major]] and the [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|Battle of Onderon]]. Such vessels were also present at the [[Conclave at Deneba|Conclave on Deneba]] shortly after the battle had ended.<ref name="TOTJ:DLOTS" />
